tools.description: WRITE: create a Cuttly short link for a long URL, optionally with a custom alias (the part after the slash). Returns the short link, the full link and the page title. It counts against the monthly link limit of the plan. Cuttly rate limit: Free 3 calls per 60 seconds, Starter 6, Single 60. The call

tools.description: Click statistics of one short link: total clicks, clicks by source (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, other, bots), top referrers, countries, device types, operating systems, browsers, device brands and languages. The date range filter needs the Team plan or higher. Counts as one API call (Free plan 3 pe

tools.name: cuttly_update_link
tools.description: WRITE: change a short link: its alias, destination URL, title, tag or unique-click window. Send only what you want to change. Changing the alias makes the old short link stop working; changing the destination redirects every visitor to the new URL at once. Link editing needs the Single plan or highe

tools.name: cuttly_set_link_expiration
tools.description: WRITE: set or remove the expiration of a short link. The link expires after a number of clicks or on a date, and can then redirect to another URL. mode 'none' removes an existing expiration. Needs the Single plan or higher. The call is sent once and never retried. GET https://cutt.ly/api/api.php?edi

tools.name: cuttly_set_device_redirect
tools.description: WRITE: send visitors on one device type to another destination (an app store page or a deep link): Android, iOS or Windows Mobile. platform 'redirect' sets the destination for all other devices. Set `remove: true` instead of a destination to delete the rule. Needs the Single plan or higher. The call

tools.name: cuttly_delete_link
tools.description: WRITE, IRREVERSIBLE: permanently delete a short link and its statistics. Anyone who opens the short link afterwards gets an error, and Cuttly cannot restore it. Ask the user to confirm the exact link before you call this. Needs the Single plan or higher. The call is sent once and never retried. GET

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cuttly_shorten_link, cuttly_update_link, cuttly_set_link_expiration · Public sink: cuttly_update_link, cuttly_set_device_redirect · Destructive: cuttly_set_link_expiration, cuttly_set_device_redirect, cuttly_delete_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cuttly_shorten_link, cuttly_update_link, cuttly_set_link_expiration · Public sink: cuttly_update_link, cuttly_set_device_redirect · Destructive: cuttly_set_link_expiration, cuttly_set_device_redirect, cuttly_delete_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
